content.short: Liteflow helps businesses launch NFT marketplaces or NFT-related products with customizable options.
content.description: Liteflow delivers end-to-end tooling for building NFT marketplaces, covering infrastructure and ready-to-run applications with a strong emphasis on customization. It starts from a fully open-source starter kit, allowing owners to tailor platform fees—fixed or dynamic—manage NFTs, and define a project token for transfers. You can also set platform restrictions to align with your business needs. Liteflow centers on giving each NFT project control over its own business, with the first step being to control your product.
content.meta: Liteflow provides infrastructure and NFT marketplace apps with customizable design and flow. Discover Liteflow and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
